title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.30108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. translated_title: 多模态具身智能体：从计算机使用到机器人使用的统一能力中心视角
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体（MMAs）通过推理、记忆、工具和反馈来维持交互，其最典型的表现形式是计算机使用智能体，而机器人系统（RSs）则在物理动力学约束下将感知与执行相结合。我们将多模态具身智能体（MMEAs）定义为目标导向的系统，它将多模态任务推理与物理行动相结合，并根据行动产生的反馈修正决策。由此引出一个核心问题：当多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，究竟发生了什么变化？我们提出了PAPAV，一个统一的以能力为中心的框架，包含五种反复出现的基本功能：感知当前状态、预判行动效果、规划可行行动路径、通过接口或身体执行行动，以及验证行动结果。这些能力由功能而非架构来定义，使PAPAV能够识别三者的共同之处，进而将MMEAs与MMAs和RSs进行比较。五种物理约束，从部分可观测性到不可验证的结果……
tldr: 本文提出了以能力为中心的统一框架PAPAV，通过感知、预判、规划、行动、验证五种核心功能，将多模态具身智能体与多模态智能体和机器人系统置于同一视角下进行比较，系统回答了智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时面临的关键变化与物理约束。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions—Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, Act, and Verify—that enables systematic comparison among multimodal embodied agents, multimodal agents, and robotic systems, addressing what fundamentally changes when an agent moves from computer-use to robot-use.
